about.title:
Shaping landscapes
that endure
about.quote: I bring together technical landscape planning and creative design thinking to shape places that endure.
paragraphs: A landscape architect working at the intersection of site-specific analysis and nature-led design. Currently based in Cambridge, I work with Pegasus Group on landscape planning, LVIA, and masterplanning across residential, commercial, and infrastructure typologies.

My practice spans baseline landscape and visual assessments, landscape character assessments, and full LVIAs — translating technical evidence into planning narratives that hold up at committee. I prepare landscape masterplans, planting proposals, and ecology management plans with equal care for ecological integrity and visual quality.

Having trained and practised across the UK, China, and India, I bring a multi-cultural lens to each project, always grounded in the specific character, ecology, and community of the site in front of me.
